mapper.select: SELECT t.*,p.* FROM team t LEFT JOIN person p ON p.team_ref=t.dept_id WHERE t.dept_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.staff_id
SELECT * FROM person WHERE team_ref=#{id} ORDER BY staff_id
SELECT p.*,t.* FROM person p JOIN team t ON t.dept_id=p.team_ref WHERE p.staff_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM team AND (label LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND city=#{city} ORDER BY dept_id

SELECT t.dept_id AS "deptId",t.label AS "deptName",COUNT(p.staff_id) AS "staffCount", COALESCE(SUM(p.wage+p.bonus),0) AS "totalPay",(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_account a JOIN person x ON x.staff_id=a.staff_id WHERE x.team_ref=t.dept_id) AS "accountCount" FROM team t LEFT JOIN person p ON p.team_ref=t.dept_id GROUP BY t.dept_id,t.label ORDER BY t.dept_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "staff_total",SUM(CASE WHEN active=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "on_job_total", SUM(wage+bonus) AS "pay_total",AVG(wage+bonus) AS "pay_avg",MIN(wage+bonus) AS "pay_min",MAX(wage+bonus) AS "pay_max" FROM person
mapper.update: UPDATE team code=#{deptCode},label=#{deptName}, city=#{city},budget_code=#{costCenter}, WHERE dept_id=#{deptId}
mapper.insert: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(staff_id),7000)+1 FROM person INSERT INTO person(staff_id,badge,full_name,position,lead_id,start_date,wage,bonus,team_ref,active) VALUES(#{staffId},CONCAT('N',#{staffId}),#{staffName},#{post},#{mentorId},#{hiredOn},#{basePay},#{meritPay},#{deptId},#{onJob})
mapper.update: UPDATE person full_name=#{staffName},position=#{post}, wage=#{basePay},bonus=#{meritPay}, team_ref=#{deptId},active=#{onJob}, WHERE staff_id=#{staffId}
UPDATE person SET team_ref=#{team} WHERE staff_id=#{id}
UPDATE person SET active=0 WHERE staff_id=#{id}
